title: XAttention: Block Sparse Attention with Antidiagonal Scoring
abstract: Long-Context Transformer Models (LCTMs) are vital for real-world applications but suffer high computational costs due to attention's quadratic complexity. Block-sparse attention mitigates this by focusing computation on critical regions, yet existing methods struggle with balancing accuracy and efficiency due to costly block importance measurements. In this paper, we introduce XAttention, a plug-and-play framework that dramatically accelerates long-context inference in Transformers models using sparse attention. XAttention's key innovation is the insight that the sum of antidiagonal values (i.e., from the lower-left to upper-right) in the attention matrix provides a powerful proxy for block importance. This allows for precise identification and pruning of non-essential blocks, resulting in high sparsity and dramatically accelerated inference. Across comprehensive evaluations on demanding long-context benchmarks—including RULER and LongBench for language, VideoMME for video understanding, and VBench for video generation—XAttention achieves accuracy comparable to full attention while delivering substantial computational gains. We demonstrate up to 13.5× acceleration in attention computation. These results underscore XAttention's ability to unlock the practical potential of block sparse attention, paving the way for scalable and efficient deployment of LCTMs in real-world applications.

gaps_and_limitations.description: Antidiagonal pattern may miss certain attention patterns that don't align with antidiagonal structure
gaps_and_limitations.impact: Potentially suboptimal block selection for specific attention patterns

gaps_and_limitations.description: Dynamic threshold prediction requires M=1000 combinations which is computationally expensive
gaps_and_limitations.impact: High overhead for threshold optimization, especially for smaller models

gaps_and_limitations.description: Fixed block size (8×8 or 16×16) may not be optimal for all attention patterns
gaps_and_limitations.impact: Suboptimal granularity for different attention distributions

gaps_and_limitations.description: Threshold optimization is per-head without considering inter-head dependencies
gaps_and_limitations.impact: Missed opportunities for further sparsity through head correlation

gaps_and_limitations.description: Pattern selection requires storing intermediate attention approximations
gaps_and_limitations.impact: Increased memory usage during pattern detection phase

gaps_and_limitations.description: Video experiments use simple frame-level attention without considering temporal patterns
gaps_and_limitations.impact: Suboptimal for complex video understanding tasks

improvements.title: Adaptive Pattern Detection
improvements.description: Use multiple pattern templates (antidiagonal, diagonal, vertical, horizontal) and dynamically select the best pattern per block
improvements.implementation: Train a lightweight classifier to select optimal pattern type for each block based on query/key statistics

runtime_change.original: [L, L, d] * (density) + [L, L/S, d] for pattern selection
runtime_change.improved: [L, L, d] * (density) + 4 * [L, L/S, d] for multi-pattern selection

improvements.title: Hierarchical Threshold Learning
improvements.description: Replace dynamic programming with learned hierarchical threshold prediction using gradient-based optimization
improvements.implementation: Use small neural network (2-layer MLP) to predict thresholds based on head statistics and context length

improvements.title: Variable Block Size
improvements.description: Use multi-scale block sizes (4×4, 8×8, 16×16) with adaptive selection based on attention entropy
improvements.implementation: Compute attention entropy per region and select appropriate block size (high entropy → smaller blocks)

runtime_change.improved: [L, L, d] * (density) + [L, L, 3] for entropy computation

improvements.title: Cross-Head Correlation
improvements.description: Exploit correlation between attention heads to share threshold information and reduce computation
improvements.implementation: Cluster similar heads using attention pattern similarity and share thresholds within clusters

runtime_change.improved: [k, L, L] * (density) + [H, k] for cluster assignments, where k << H

improvements.expected_benefit: 30% reduction in threshold parameters, 1% accuracy improvement

improvements.title: Memory-Efficient Pattern Selection
improvements.description: Use streaming computation for pattern selection to reduce memory overhead
improvements.implementation: Process attention blocks in streaming fashion, keeping only current block in memory

improvements.title: Temporal Pattern Extension
improvements.description: Extend antidiagonal pattern to 3D for video (spatial + temporal dimensions)
improvements.implementation: Use 3D antidiagonal planes for spatio-temporal attention in video models

innovative_points.explanation: Revolutionary insight that antidiagonal sums serve as efficient proxies for block importance, enabling lightweight yet accurate attention pattern detection
innovative_points.novelty: First work to systematically explore antidiagonal patterns for attention sparsity
innovative_points.impact: Enables 24.9× faster pattern selection compared to existing methods

innovative_points.explanation: Plug-and-play framework requiring no model retraining or fine-tuning, making it immediately deployable
innovative_points.novelty: Achieves competitive performance without costly training procedures
innovative_points.impact: Reduces deployment barrier from weeks to minutes

innovative_points.explanation: Dynamic programming approach for per-head threshold optimization, adapting to different attention patterns across heads
innovative_points.novelty: First systematic approach to head-specific threshold optimization in sparse attention
innovative_points.impact: Improves both accuracy and sparsity simultaneously

innovative_points.explanation: Comprehensive evaluation across language, video understanding, and video generation domains
innovative_points.novelty: First sparse attention method validated on such diverse multimodal tasks

innovative_points.explanation: Novel warmup approach for video generation models to preserve layout quality during denoising
innovative_points.novelty: First systematic study of warmup strategies for sparse attention in diffusion models
innovative_points.impact: Enables high-fidelity video generation with 50% sparsity
